scope: perplexity target coverage, denominator, accumulation precision, and cache lifetime
lm-eval-compatible zero-shot protocol and cache lifetime
LongCodeQA, MATH-500, and RULER protocol identity
repo-local Slurm/SSH result and failure lifecycle

perplexity.target_contract: each global next-token target in [1,traversed_end) exactly once
perplexity.disjoint_multiwindow_stride: rejected because the first target after every reset boundary would be unscored
perplexity.nll_accumulation: fp32 token cross-entropy, per-window fp64 sum, host binary64 math.fsum
perplexity.cache_lifetime: each window cache and all window outputs are released before the next cache factory; tokenized input IDs remain as the sole cross-window tensor

zero_shot.cache_lifetime: protocol probe is released after dependency snapshot and before the first choice cache; every choice cache is released before the next factory

longbench_e.adaptation: official prompts, truncation, generation budgets, and scorers; model-native non-thinking chat wrapper is explicitly non-reference-exact

longcodeqa.adaptation: released A-D parser with deterministic greedy max_new_tokens=16; upstream response/text key inconsistency prevents claiming exact released decoding execution

math500.adaptation: explicitly labelled composite protocol; bare gold answer fragments are wrapped in inline-math delimiters before Math-Verify parsing

ruler_v1.adaptation: explicitly not labelled as the canonical NVIDIA 500-sample/task protocol

result_lifecycle.result_root_contract: direct child of papers/hayatequant_paper/experiments/results in a separate linked worktree at the exact source commit
result_lifecycle.success_contract: regular nonempty strict JSON object with duplicate keys and non-finite numbers rejected; bytes and SHA-256 captured atomically
result_lifecycle.aggregate_contract: every formal source has exactly one matching successful submission/worker attempt; every submitted attempt has a terminal worker receipt; failed retries remain retained

limitations: This audit changes benchmark correctness and evidence handling only; it does not supply refreshed GPU measurements.
MATH-500, LongCodeQA, LongBench chat wrapping, and NeMo-Skills RULER are retained with explicit adaptation labels rather than misrepresented as fully reference-exact protocols.
